'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Ukraine–European Union relations]], [[Ukraine–United States relations]]
***[[European Commission]] [[President of the European Commission|President]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]] announces that the [[European Union]] will give [[Ukraine]] [[Euro|€]]3.4 billion (USD$3.6 billion) throughout the summer from Russian [[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine|frozen assets]] revenue. [https://kyivindependent.com/von-der-leyen-ukraine-to-receive-1-5-billion-euros-in-russian-frozen-assets-revenue-in-july/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
***The [[United States]] approves a move to send a second [[MIM-104 Patriot|Patriot missile system]] to Ukraine. [https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-russia-patriot-missile-systems-us-aid-62deb8e2c4653dfc27949f81bfa43255 (AP)]
**[[Belarus–Russia relations]]
***[[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] begin the second stage of their [[tactical nuclear weapon]]s drills. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/belarus-ap-ukraine-russia-vladimir-putin-b2560454.html (''The Independent'')]
**Russia says that it has captured the villages of Tymkivka in [[Kharkiv Oblast]] and Miasozharivka in [[Luhansk Oblast]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/russia-says-captured-two-more-eastern-ukrainian-villages-15bef1ea (''Barron's'' via AFP)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Humanitarian aid during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[United States Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] announces more than $400 million in new humanitarian aid for [[Palestinian]]s in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/11/politics/antony-blinken-gaza-aid-humanitarian/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|Islamic State insurgency in Iraq]]
**[[Iraqi security forces]] in cooperation with [[United States Armed Forces|U.S.]]-led [[coalition]] forces kill Abu Zainab, a senior member of [[Islamic State]] in [[Raqqa]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraqi-forces-kill-senior-islamic-state-leader-raid-syria-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Senior Hezbollah commander [[Taleb Abdallah]] and three other militants are killed in an Israeli strike on a control center in [[Jwaya]], [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-lebanon-kills-four-including-senior-hezbollah-commander-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
**Hezbollah launches 90 rockets at IDF targets of a factory, center station in [[Ein Zeitim]] and [[Ami'ad]] and an airforce surveillance station in [[Meron]], 70 at the [[Mount Meron]] area, ten more at [[Zar'it]], and launching 145 more. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-lebanon-kills-four-including-senior-hezbollah-commander-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Korean conflict]]
**[[South Korea]] says that its [[Republic of Korea Army|forces]] fired [[warning shot]]s at [[North Korea]]n [[Korean People's Army|soldiers]] who briefly crossed the demarcation line in the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone]]. South Korean authorities state that they believe the intrusion, which occurred in a densely forested area, was accidental. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-fired-warning-shots-weekend-after-border-incursion-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[International Organization for Migration]] says that more than 10 million people have now been [[Internally displaced person|internally displaced]] by the war in [[Sudan]], including around a third of the population of the capital [[Khartoum]], making it the world's worst displacement crisis. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/11/more-than-10-million-displaced-in-war-torn-sudan-iom-says (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[World Bank]] approves $1 billion for the construction of the [[Dasu Dam]] in northwest [[Pakistan]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/06/11/world-bank-approves-a-1-billion-loan-for-pakistan-s-key-hydropower-project (Al-Arabiya)]
*Production begins at [[Senegal]]'s first [[offshore drilling|offshore oil project]] at the Sangomar oil fields which aims to produce 100,000 barrels of oil per day. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/production-starts-senegals-offshore-oil-project-111017151 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Chikangawa Dornier 228 crash]]
**The wreckage of an aircraft which went missing yesterday in [[Malawi]] amid bad weather is found. All ten people on board, including the country's [[Vice-President of Malawi|Vice-President]] [[Saulos Chilima]], are confirmed dead. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/malawi-president-all-killed-plane-carrying-vice-president-chilima-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 European floods#Spain|2024 Spain floods]]
** Floods hit the Spanish island of [[Majorca]], affecting the third busiest airport in Europe. ([https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/06/11/torrential-rain-floods-majorca-airport-spain/ The Telegraph])
*A [[Russian Aerospace Forces]] [[Sukhoi Su-34]] aircraft crashes during a routine training exercise in [[North Ossetia–Alania]], [[Russia]], killing both crew onboard. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-su-34-bomber-crashes-caucasus-crew-killed-agencies-report-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–Sri Lanka relations]], [[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Sri Lanka]]'s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Sri Lanka)|foreign ministry]] says that the country has received assurances from Russia that it would stop recruiting Sri Lankan citizens to fight in Ukraine. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/06/11/russia-to-stop-recruiting-fighters-from-sri-lanka-colombo-says- (Al-Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime''' 
*[[Weiss special counsel investigation]]
**[[Hunter Biden]], son of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]], is convicted in a federal court in [[Delaware]] on three felony counts of possession of a firearm while under the influence of narcotics. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/verdict-reached-hunter-biden-gun-trial-rcna155458 (NBC News)]
*A man [[self-immolation|self-immolates]] at [[St. Mark's Square, Zagreb|St. Mark's Square]] in [[Zagreb]], [[Croatia]], and later dies in hospital. [https://n1info.ba/english/news/man-sets-himself-on-fire-in-zagrebs-st-marks-square/ (N1)] [https://dnevnik.hr/vijesti/hrvatska/muskarac-se-polio-benzinom-i-zapalio-ispred-zgrade-vlade-rh---853094.html (Dnevnik)]
*Riots occur in [[Tiaret]], [[Algeria]], in opposition to water rationing as a government response to prolonged droughts. [https://apnews.com/article/algeria-drought-rain-tebboune-tiaret-riots-09ce23f4ba235aaf1e3afecc7bfe3574 (AP)]
*Eight individuals from [[Tajikistan]] with suspected ties to [[Islamic State]] are arrested across several United States cities for border immigration violations. [https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-border-fbi-homeland-security-7088e6f665f095ad38186cafe69bbddd (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Austrian legislative election]]
**[[Austria]] announces that [[Austrian parliament|parliamentary]] elections will be held on September 29. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/austria-confirms-parliamentary-election-be-held-end-september-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 French legislative election]]
**[[France]]'s [[Left-wing politics|left-wing]] political parties establish an electoral alliance, the [[New Popular Front]], ahead of the French parliamentary elections. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/politics/article/2024/06/11/french-left-agrees-to-form-new-popular-front-in-parliamentary-elections_6674465_5.html#/ (''Le Monde'')]
*[[2024 Limerick mayoral election]]
**[[John Moran (Mayor of Limerick)|John Moran]] becomes the first directly-elected mayor in the [[Republic of Ireland]]. [https://www.limerick.ie/count/mayor-of-limerick-election-results/ (Limerick.ie)]
*[[2024 South African general election]]
**Former [[South Africa]]n [[President of South Africa|president]] [[Jacob Zuma]] and his party [[uMkhonto weSizwe (political party)|uMkhonto weSizwe]] appeal to the [[Constitutional Court of South Africa|Constitutional Court]] to block the newly elected parliament from sitting, citing [[electoral fraud]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/zumas-mk-party-seeks-stop-south-african-parliaments-first-sitting-after-election-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**[[Hunger strike]]s occur in at least 16 prisons in [[Venezuela]] to protest against poor living conditions such as [[overcrowding]] as well as delays in the reviews of the prisoners' judicial processes. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/in-venezuela-prisoners-stage-hunger-strikes-in-at-least-16-centers/ar-BB1o2sNc (MSN via Reuters)]
